title: Administrative Leave for Workforce Realignment and Other Purposes
pass_4_primary_concern: The public record is thin on how OPM will standardize broad discretionary leave decisions and edge-case line drawing across agencies.
pass_5_high_stakes_domain_reason: The proposal concerns federal personnel leave and resignation administration rather than emergency deprivation of liberty or another high-stakes public restriction regime.
pass_5_concise_why: The proposal is structurally ordinary, but it concentrates discretion in agency decisionmakers and leaves several boundary rules under-specified.
pass_5_most_important_consequence: Agencies may apply leave and resignation rules unevenly unless OPM gives clearer examples, documentation standards, and oversight hooks.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The rule stays within OPM's administrative-leave and resignation authority rather than substituting a different legal regime.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: No special structural comment is needed beyond ordinary record support.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The proposal does not flip the statute; it tries to codify and clarify within the existing framework.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: No special structural comment is needed beyond ordinary record support.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: Agency heads retain responsibility, but the public record does not shift accountability away from the agencies in a way that looks structurally novel.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask how OPM will keep agency-level discretion visible and reviewable.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: Agencies will still make and document their own leave decisions, although OPM supplies the regulatory frame.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask for examples of independent OPM review or oversight.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The 10-workday and 1-workday thresholds create sequencing rules, but those are the intended mechanics rather than a hidden control layer.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask for examples showing how the thresholds work in mixed-duty situations.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The rule changes real personnel consequences, but the visible record gives only a short cost and impact discussion.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask OPM to show the assumptions behind the de minimis-cost conclusion.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The remedies generally fit the stated rationale of codifying policy and clarifying discretion, even though the public bridge is somewhat compressed.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask OPM to show which changes are required by statute and which are policy choices.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: Implementation relies on ordinary HR and leave administration rather than a novel mechanism, so the risk is mostly consistency, not fantasy.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask for implementation examples and model agency instructions.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The proposal depends on agencies understanding and applying the leave and resignation rules consistently, but that is an ordinary regulatory dependency.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask how OPM will make the agency-to-agency handoff legible.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The notice identifies the relevant leave and resignation issues, but several border cases remain only partially explained.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask for more examples of the edge cases most likely to create disputes.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The impact discussion acknowledges some effects, but it remains light on detailed treatment of administrative and employee-side impacts.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask OPM to quantify the administrative burden it expects agencies to absorb.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The broader discretion could be applied unevenly, but the rule does not obviously create a selective targeting system.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask for anti-arbitrariness examples rather than a generic discretion statement.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The proposal leaves many safeguards to existing agency practice and does not add many new process protections for hard cases.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask for documentation and minimum-notice standards for discretionary decisions.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: Some burden shifts to agencies and employees, but that burden shift is part of the personnel framework rather than a novel externality dump.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask who bears the HR and payroll burden in edge cases.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The proposal does not create a generalized suspicion or watchlist mechanism.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: No special structural comment is needed beyond ordinary record support.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The notice codifies agency discretion without creating a parallel public reporting architecture that would make later review easier.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask OPM to preserve more nonconfidential traceability in the final rule.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The proposal does not create a regime that obviously allows harm before any review channel exists.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: No special structural comment is needed beyond ordinary record support.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The rule places agency officials at the controlling gate for extended leave and resignation-withdrawal decisions, but the public record does not supply much beyond that broad discretion.

evidence.quote_or_absence: An agency may at its sole and exclusive discretion provide administrative leave
An agency may, in its sole and exclusive discretion, accept or decline an employee's request to withdraw his or her resignation

pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask OPM to publish documentation standards and review criteria for the decisions now sitting at the agency gate.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The rule distinguishes leave categories and resignation states, but some outcome classes remain under-explained at the edges.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask OPM to distinguish the most common borderline outcomes.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: Undefined terms and broad discretion could be used to gate benefits unevenly unless the agency adds more examples.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask for model examples and fallback criteria.

pass_5_flaws.explanation: The package is coherent overall, even if several of the new boundaries need operational guidance.
pass_5_flaws.comment_leverage: Ask OPM to tighten the public mapping between policy intent and agency implementation.
